name: Emperor Xian of Han
role: Emperor of the Han dynasty from 189 to 220
contribution: The 14th and last emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty of China.
legacy: In late 220, some months after Cao Cao's death, Cao Cao's successor, Cao Pi, forced this person to abdicate the throne to him.

checks.lead: Emperor Xian of Han (2 April 181 – 21 April 234), personal name Liu Xie (劉協), courtesy name Bohe, was the 14th and last emperor of the Eastern Han dynasty of China. He reigned from 28 September 189 until his abdication and subsequent end of the dynasty on 11 December 220.
